maria_torres: AcmeHealth returned the vendor risk form. They highlighted three asks: confirm SOC2 scope, clarify embeddings retention/deletion flow, and BYOK options. They want answers before Friday for the renewal.

josh_kim: Quick answers to build on: SOC2 scope = production systems for hosted API; non-prod and review environments are out of scope unless requested. Default embeddings retention = 30 days; customers can request shorter. Deletion = async purge with audit log. BYOK = supported via customer KMS (GCP/AWS) for hosted; full HSM/BYOK requires Dedicated/Private and an onboarding plan.

alex_cheng: Legal note 12: we can sign our standard DPA. For BYOK/HSM we need an engineering attestation on key handling and an evidence artifact for audits (deletion attestation + access logs). Ask them if BYOK is mandatory for renewal.

maria_torres: Pasting a suggested Q/A for the form so it's copy/paste ready: 

```
Q: Are embeddings or other derived vectors stored, and what is the retention and deletion process?
A: Embeddings are stored for up to 30 days by default for hosted customers. Customers may request a shorter retention period or immediate deletion. Deletion requests create an asynchronous purge job and an audit log entry; live storage and KV caches are cleared and final purges typically complete within 24 hours. For customers requiring customer-managed encryption, we support integration with cloud KMS (AWS/GCP) for hosted plans. Full BYOK with HSM or on-prem key material is available for Dedicated/Private deployments and requires a short onboarding/validation process. Evidence of deletion and access logs can be provided for audits on request.
```

sophie_liu: Sophie (eng) 12: we'll open ENGOPS-1427 to capture steps and timeline. For cloud KMS onboarding (hosted) we can complete in ~48 hours after customer provides IAM/service account details. Dedicated/Private BYOK/HSM: estimate 3-4 weeks depending on procurement and HSM access. I'll add the purge job runbook excerpt to the ticket.

alex_cheng: Add one line offering a deletion attestation PDF for audit cycles. Also ask them what retention they expect (30/7/0) and whether BYOK is non-negotiable for renewal.

maria_torres: I'll send this back now. Will ping once they reply. Tagging @sophie_liu for ENGOPS-1427 ETA and @josh_kim for attestation language.
